title: Fix CryptoTracker EOD schedule startup failure
current: P-20260927-03 compiled successfully but exited immediately with code 1 after deployment.
proposed: Move CRYPTO_EOD_ONCE_DATE out of the numeric DEFAULTS loader and read it directly from the environment. Preserve tonight's 10:30 PM Pacific one-time target and 10:00 PM Pacific recurring schedule.
evidence: load_settings() converts every non-int DEFAULTS entry with env_float().
P-20260927-03 added CRYPTO_EOD_ONCE_DATE as a string DEFAULT and .env.config set it to 2026-09-27, which cannot be parsed as float.
The resulting configuration exception occurs during startup, explaining the immediate exit code 1.
risk: Low. This fixes configuration parsing only; all trading rules and protected capabilities are unchanged.
status_note: User explicitly requested the failed CryptoTracker deployment be fixed.

implementation.root_cause: CRYPTO_EOD_ONCE_DATE string was incorrectly routed through numeric env_float() loader.
implementation.tonight: If tonight's EOD report has not already been sent, the trader will send it after startup because the configured one-time time has passed.
